neighbours.label: a split-off word-initial ' r' / ' R' piece: the start of an r-word the tokenizer breaks into ' r' + rest (r|ations, r|avioli, r|ansacked)
fire: During the long siege the garrison survived on half rations for weeks.
For dinner my grandmother served homemade ravioli with sage butter.
When we came home we found that burglars had ransacked the flat.
The teacher struggled to calm a class of rambunctious eight-year-olds.
After the hike everyone was ravenous and ate in silence.
The museum's new wing is devoted to fossil raptors from Mongolia.
We climbed a rickety ladder up to the hayloft.
The orchestra closed the concert with a Hungarian rhapsody.
quiet: During the long siege the garrison survived on boiled rice for weeks.
For dinner my grandmother served homemade rabbit stew with sage butter.
When we came home we found that burglars had broken into the flat.
The teacher struggled to calm a class of restless eight-year-olds.
After the hike everyone was really hungry and ate in silence.
The museum's new wing is devoted to fossil reptiles from Mongolia.
We climbed a wooden ladder up to the hayloft.
The orchestra closed the concert with a Hungarian dance.

notes: Near misses keep r-words that are whole tokens (rice, rabbit, restless, really, reptiles) or swap the word; only the split ' r' piece is removed. Tokenization checked with the model's tokenizer.json.
